items.title: Watch: Are the French riots a warning of an intense election to come?
items.summary: Rioting, looting and vandalism has gripped France over the weekend after protests spiralled out of control across the country.

items.title: Australian MP critically injured after being hit by car in apparent attack
items.summary: The independent politician is in hospital after what the prime minister says may have been a deliberate attack.

items.title: Woman says she 'closed eyes and tried not to be there' during alleged Russell Brand rape
items.summary: The 51-year-old faces three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

items.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
items.summary: Self-proclaimed pastor Paul Mackenzie was found guilty of 191 murder charges - all but one of them children.

items.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support says court filing
items.summary: The Saudi government did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment.

items.title: Born in jail to a mum with a heroin addiction - how US teenager Abby has been affected by drugs
items.summary: The BBC's Quentin Sommerville spoke to the daughter of a former heroin addict about the effect drugs have had on her family.

items.title: Possible wreckage of Amelia Earhart's plane likely to be trees, say researchers
items.summary: Researchers travelled to a remote Pacific Island to confirm whether an object first spotted on satellite imagery in 2020 solved the mystery of the pilot's disappearance.

items.title: Mission set to blast off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
items.summary: A spacecraft is set to launch on an ambitious mission to bring 10g of Martian moon dust back to Earth.
